function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the public web and return normalized titles, URLs, publication dates, and highlights.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 10.

category.description: Optional provider category such as news.

include_domains.description: Optional hostname filters such as example.com.

start_published_date.description: Optional lower publication-date bound in RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD form.

include_highlights.description: Request provider-generated highlights. Defaults to true.

highlight_sentences.description: Number of highlight sentences to request. Defaults to 3.
